site.name: RetailPulse
site.tagline: Retail analytics and guarded AI over a SQL star schema
site.author: Nikhil Chary Sriramoju

pages.title: Retail Analytics Dashboard with Guarded AI | RetailPulse
pages.description: RetailPulse is a retail analytics platform on a SQL star schema: KPIs, demand forecasting, churn, a RAG assistant and a guarded agent. Synthetic data.
pages.intro: Net revenue excludes returned orders. Every figure comes from the SQL star-schema warehouse. The data is synthetic (fixed seed), so the pipeline is real and the business is not.

pages.title: Customer Analytics: RFM, Churn Risk, Cohorts | RetailPulse
pages.description: RFM segments, a temporally validated churn model, cohort retention and a no-PII customer 360 view, all computed from a SQL warehouse of synthetic orders.
pages.intro: RFM segments, churn risk, a no-PII customer 360 and cohort retention. Customers appear only as anonymous keys.

pages.title: Demand Forecast, Backtest and Anomalies | RetailPulse
pages.description: Daily net revenue forecast with an empirical range, a backtest against seasonal-naive and moving-average baselines, and flash-sale anomaly detection.
pages.intro: Daily net revenue forecast with an empirical range, a backtest against simple baselines, and anomaly detection. The model under-forecasts and the page says so.

pages.title: Scenario Planner: Profit What-If Model | RetailPulse
pages.description: Interactive what-if model for retail profit: change price, discount, returns and cost inflation on a 12-month warehouse baseline and test demand elasticity.
pages.intro: Change price, discount, returns and costs and see the effect on revenue, margin and profit. Baseline numbers come from the warehouse; the behavioural assumptions are sliders.

pages.title: AI Assistant: Guarded Agent and Cited RAG | RetailPulse
pages.description: Ask in plain English. A tool-using agent calls allow-listed read-only tools and shows each step; a RAG assistant answers with citations or abstains.
pages.intro: Ask in plain English. The agent plans, calls allow-listed read-only tools and shows each step. The knowledge base answers with citations or says it does not know.

pages.title: SQL Explorer with Read-Only Query Guard | RetailPulse
pages.description: The SQL library behind the dashboards and a guarded console. Every query runs read-only through an authorizer allow-list that nulls personal data.
pages.intro: The SQL library behind the dashboards, and a guarded console. Everything runs read-only through the same guard the agent uses. Try the attack examples.

pages.title: Product Image Classifier (CNN and MLP) | RetailPulse
pages.description: A small CNN/MLP image classifier that assigns a product category to a tile. Trained on synthetic icons to show the pipeline, not real-photo accuracy.
pages.intro: A small CNN/MLP that assigns a product category to a tile image. Trained on synthetic icons, so it shows the pipeline, not real-photo performance.

pages.title: Security Controls, Model Registry and Drift | RetailPulse
pages.description: Security controls, a model registry with promotion gates, PSI drift monitoring, data-quality checks and a verifiable hash-chained audit log, with evidence.
pages.intro: Security controls, a model registry with promotion gates, drift monitoring and quality checks, with the evidence behind each.

pages.title: REST API Reference (OpenAPI 3.1) | RetailPulse
pages.description: REST API reference generated from the OpenAPI 3.1 document: endpoints, roles (viewer, analyst, admin), request bodies and curl examples.
pages.intro: Generated from the OpenAPI 3.1 document. Roles are cumulative: viewer < analyst < admin.

pages.title: About RetailPulse, Architecture and Limitations
pages.description: How RetailPulse is built, what it measures honestly, and its limitations: synthetic data, an under-forecasting model and a small self-written eval set.
pages.intro: A portfolio-grade analytics platform built to show the whole stack honestly: data, models, AI, security, MLOps and a real web app.
